scope: First build-input slice: Cargo layout facts from exact manifest bytes, a pure planner with the cargo_compatibility.v1 and nix_compatibility.v1 profiles and a plan identity, and a typed two-project Cargo corpus qualified through the projected materializer with real Cargo executions under a cleared environment.
immediate_outcome: A view holding alpha, its shared path dependency and the root lockfile, configuration and toolchain files is planned and passes its tests with its entries unchanged. A view whose code reads a file of another package fails although the working checkout holds that file. Views without the dependency or the configuration, and a relocated view, are refused before anything runs. An edit to the shared dependency through the alpha view selects beta, which the view does not hold.
durable_capability: kiln_core::projection::build_inputs (plan_cargo, plan_nix, BuildInputPlan::accepts_evidence), kiln_build_graph::cargo_layout, config/build-input-contracts.ncl with its fixtures and checked export fixtures/build-inputs/corpus.json, and the harness shared by the off-by-default build-input-qualification example and the build_input_qualification test, whose build-input-fixtures feature runs in the build-input-fixtures Nix check.
ordering: The proposal, design and tasks gates passed before any implementation file was written.

observations: A literal workspace member that is absent, or present without its targets, stops a build of another member.
A wholly absent glob member is ignored; a glob member present without its targets stops the build.
With --locked and no lockfile, Cargo refuses to create one.
Without --locked and with a member absent, Cargo rewrites the lockfile; with --locked the restricted view built and left the lockfile unchanged.
